## Before the exercises

Ordinary sections keep their automatic numbers. Exercise headings show their
label instead.

## Exercises

A heading titled Exercises marks the level-3 headings below it as questions.

### Compute the sample mean

Eight delivery times, in minutes, are 31, 28, 35, 30, 33, 29, 34, and 32.
Compute their mean.

### Pick the median {data-kind="M"}

`data-kind="M"` makes this a multiple-choice item with its own counter.

::: {.alpha-list}
- 31
- 31.5
- 32
:::

### Explain the difference {#exr-explain}

Explain why the mean and the median can differ.

## Included exercise

An exercise file usually starts with a level-1 heading. The include moves it to
level 3 and labels its first heading.

::: {.exercise-include target-level="3"}
# Trace the running total

Trace `total` after each of the values 4, 7, and 3.

## Hint

Start with `total = 0`.
:::
